nodes.title: Hadamard's inequality and determinant bounds for positive semidefinite matrices

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be Hermitian $n \times n$ complex matrices with eigenvalues $\lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_n$ and $\mu_1 \ge \dots \ge \mu_n$ respectively, counted with multiplicity. Then $\sum_{i=1}^n (\lambda_i - \mu_i)^2 \le \sum_{i=1}^n \sum_{j=1}^n |A_{ij} - B_{ij}|^2$, that is, the left side is at most the squared Frobenius norm of $A - B$.
nodes.title: Hoffman–Wielandt inequality for Hermitian matrices

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be positive definite real square matrices indexed by a finite set with $n$ elements. Then $\log(\det A \cdot \det B) \le \operatorname{tr}(AB) - n$.
nodes.title: Log-determinant trace inequality
